My thesis on BOW is pretty simple: 

> The big winners of a new ecosystems/chains are usually the foundational infra plays that many are currently overlooking as they are so focused on memes and making a quick flip 

> BOW is the credit layer for Robinhood Chain -  the protocol that turns tokenized stocks, RWAs, crypto, and memes into borrowable collateral instead of dead inventory - think of it as them trying to be what Kamino is on SOL but for Robinhood Chain 

> The native TVL on BOW is still relatively little, which is normal as its a nascent protocol with around 4-5m TVL. Watching the TVL increase closely, if this continues to grow and attract liquidity the price of BOW should naturally increase as well 

> Team is doxxed and actively hired some top crypto talent which is a great sign - most of the teams right now are fully anon and you don't have any insights into them building a real business
